name: YMCA of Silicon Valley Youth and Government
what_you_do: High school students model the California legislature and courts, build public speaking and writing skills, and can earn service hours. The program is over 75 years old.
who_can_apply: High school students from across California (per the page). No other rules stated.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page; ask the YMCA
deadline_text: Dates and fees were not on the page.
how_to_apply: Use the 'Sign up for more information' form on the YMCA leadership page.
notes: The same page lists a Friday Night Live Council, a Youth Technology Incubator Leadership Council and other teen programs. Dates, cost and conference details are not on the page.
